_comment: Generated by ui_parity_audit.py; class-3 operators with reasons. T6 treats keymap chords / menu entries bound to these as intentional gaps.

chords.alt+A:PRESS: automasking pie withheld: only cavity is mapped
chords.alt+W:PRESS: face-sets pie withheld: 3 of 4 slots are visibility ops

operators.curves.convert_to_particle_system: sculpt-curves menu; different object type, out of scope
operators.object.transfer_mode: alt-Q object switch; needs custom-mode support in the C op
operators.paint.hide_show: needs engine visibility attribute + draw support
operators.paint.sample_color: color-paint sampling; revisit with COLOR-brush UX
operators.sculpt.detail_flood_fill: uniform remesh-to-detail not exposed by the engine; revisit
operators.sculpt.face_sets_init: topology/material analysis modes; simple ones may move to 2 later
operators.sculpt.mesh_filter: sculpt filter framework not in engine
operators.sculpt.paint_mask_extract: mesh extraction; possible later via flush + mesh ops
operators.sculpt.project_line_gesture: line projection (gesture deform) not in engine
operators.sculpt.sample_detail_size: samples Blender dyntopo/voxel detail; revisit with engine dyntopo UX
operators.sculpt.symmetrize: topology symmetrize not in engine (stroke mirroring is, see symmetry.py)
operators.transform.translate: sculpt transform (pivot) path not in engine
